arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ تَبَّت يَدا أَبى لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ
translation: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish

arabic: ما أَغنىٰ عَنهُ مالُهُ وَما كَسَبَ
transliteration: Ma aghna AAanhu maluhu wama kasaba
translation: His wealth and gains will not exempt him
He will be plunged in flaming Fire
Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre
